{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Duplicator

}}
{{E|Duplicator}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than normal events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Pray}} {{TS|positive||Duplicate a card in your deck.}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Before you lies a decorated altar to some ancient entity.
</div>

{{Frame|Pray}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You kneel respectfully. A ghastly mirror image appears from the shrine and collides into you.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You ignore the shrine, confident in your choice.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
